verdict: ROAS dropped sharply this week; creative refresh and fixes are underway.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your Meta ads returned a 3.77 return on ad spend on $1,531.76 in spend, generating 38 purchases and $5,773 in revenue — a solid baseline. However, the most recent 7 days tell a harder story: purchases fell 45.45% and return on ad spend dropped 47.15% versus the prior 7 days, with the last three days producing just 2 purchases. The lead cause appears to be creative fatigue in your top campaign, which accounts for over half of total budget and has been running to a shrinking audience pool. At the same time, more website sessions are arriving but fewer are converting, so we're investigating whether a checkout or landing page issue is adding friction. Ad creative is being refreshed this week, and the conversion and funnel infrastructure — subscribe pages, automated flows, and tracking — is being brought fully live to give your campaigns a complete foundation going into October.
